name: Nanticoke (United States)
description: Banner of the city arms: red over blue divided by a broad yellow embattled bar bearing three fleurs-de-lis, with a yellow bar and three yellow discs on the red.
history: Nanticoke is a city in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania. The flag was adopted on 17 May 1976 (the arms from which the banner is taken were created by Lt. Col. Andrew Winiarczyk, redesigned by Richard Crossett and adopted by the city council on 17 May 1976 on the recommendation of the Nanticoke Bicentennial Committee, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: embattled bar with three fleurs-de-lis and three discs
